entities.name: UPDATE-NEEDED state
entities.description: UE state where certain restrictions apply to user data and signaling transmission, and specific procedures are allowed.

entities.name: Service Request procedure
entities.description: Procedure triggered in response to paging to establish signaling connection.

entities.name: Tracking Area Updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE location in the network.

entities.name: PDN connection for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Procedure to establish PDN connection for emergency services.

entities.name: MMTEL voice/video call procedure
entities.description: Procedure for initiating MMTEL voice or video calls.

entities.name: SMS procedures
entities.description: Procedures for SMS over IP, SMS over NAS, or SMS over S102.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed when eCall only mode is configured and timers T3444 or T3445 expire.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer used in eCall only mode for inactivity procedures.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer used in eCall only mode for inactivity procedures.

entities.name: eCall only mode configured
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

relations.description: UPDATE-NEEDED state allows Service Request procedure when triggered by paging.
UPDATE-NEEDED state allows Tracking Area Updating procedure when triggered by paging.
UPDATE-NEEDED state allows PDN connection for emergency bearer services.
UPDATE-NEEDED state allows MMTEL voice/video call procedures.
UPDATE-NEEDED state allows SMS procedures (SMSoIP, SMS over NAS, SMS over S102).
eCall only mode configuration requires performing eCall inactivity procedure at timer expiry.
Timer T3444 expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
Timer T3445 expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
